caseName: Murel v. Baltimore City Criminal Court
caseNameFull: Murel v. Baltimore City Criminal Court
judges: Argue, Behalf, Counsel, Granted, Motion, Should, Stewart, That

opinions.text:
C. A. 4th Cir. [Certiorari granted, 404 U. S. 999.] Motion of petitioners for additional time for oral argument denied.

Mr. Justice Stewart is of the opinion that the motion should be granted. Motion for additional counsel to argue on behalf of petitioners granted.
